scripts.rust:clippy: cargo clippy -p sumurai-backend -p entity -p sumurai-cli --locked --all-targets --no-deps -- -D warnings
scripts.rust:lint: bun run rust:fmt && bun run rust:clippy
scripts.rust:test:ci: RUST_BACKTRACE=1 cargo test -p sumurai-backend -p sumurai-cli --locked && cargo test -p sumurai-backend --locked --features dev-seed seed_password
scripts.backend:ci: bun run rust:fmt && bun run rust:typecheck && bun run rust:clippy && bun run rust:test:ci
scripts.frontend:ci: bun ci && bun run --filter frontend lint && bun run --filter frontend typecheck && bun run --filter frontend design:guard && bun run --filter frontend test:ci && bun run --filter frontend build && bun run --filter frontend playwright:install-ci && bun run --filter frontend test:storybook && bun run --filter frontend storybook:build && bun run --filter frontend test:storybook-runtime:run
scripts.precommit: bun run --filter frontend precommit && bun run backend:ci
